agent_output.affected_group: Operators of vessels (recreational boaters, spectator craft, commercial vessels) and persons on navigable waters of the Ninth Coast Guard District (Great Lakes) near tall ships participating in the Tall Ships Challenge Great Lakes 2022 (Erie, PA; Cleveland, OH; Two Harbors, MN)
agent_output.change_summary: The Coast Guard proposes (NPRM) a temporary safety zone (33 CFR 165.T09-0163) covering all navigable waters within a 100 yard radius of any tall ship participating in the Tall Ships Challenge 2022 in the Great Lakes, from 12:01 a.m. June 24, 2022 through 12:01 a.m. August 29, 2022. No person or vessel may enter the zone without COTP/official patrol authorization; in confined harbors vessels may operate inside at minimum safe speed but not within 25 yards of a tall ship; moored/anchored vessels must remain stationary while in the zone. Comments due May 2, 2022.

evidence.quote:
DATES: Comments and related material must be received by the Coast 
Guard on or May 2, 2022.

SUMMARY: The Coast Guard proposes to create safety zones around each 
tall ship visiting the Great Lakes during the Tall Ships Challenge 2022 
race series.

The Coast Guard proposes to establish safety zones from 12:01 a.m. 
on June 24, 2022, until 12:01 a.m. on August 29, 2022. The safety zones 
would cover all navigable waters within 100 yards of a tall ship in the 
Great Lakes.

(c) Regulations. (1) No person or vessel is allowed within the 
safety zone unless authorized by the cognizant Captain of the Port, 
their designated representative, or the on-scene official patrol.

Vessels operating within the safety zone shall 
not come within 25 yards of a tall ship unless authorized by the 
cognizant Captain of the Port, their designated representative, or the 
on-scene official patrol.

(b) Location. The following areas are safety zones: All navigable 
waters of the United States located in the Ninth Coast Guard District 
within a 100 yard radius of any tall ship.

The combination of large 
numbers of recreational boaters, congested waterways, boaters crossing 
commercially transited waterways and low maneuverability of the tall 
ships could easily result in serious injuries or fatalities.

While some owners or operators of vessels intending to transit the 
safety zone may be small entities

(d) Effective period. This section is effective from 12:01 a.m. on 
June 24, 2022, through 12:01 a.m. on August 29, 2022.

uncertainties: Proposed rule (NPRM), not final; effective_at 2022-06-24 is the proposed start, contingent on a final rule.
DATES section has an apparent typo ('on or May 2, 2022').
Background text phrases the zone as if certain; treated as proposed.
Signed March 23, 2022, filed 3-31-22; publication date differs from signature date.
Temporary, event-specific regulation; relevance as a demand precursor is limited.
